scope: Partial nested source candidates; not complete source coverage or release approval.

records.name: qcms-crate
records.evidence: Shipped WASM panic-path strings identify qcms-0.3.0; checksum also matches wrapper Cargo.lock. Not a full dependency graph.

records.name: wasm-bindgen-crate
records.evidence: Shipped WASM producers section and panic paths identify 0.2.126, unlike the wrapper lockfile. Macro/support crates and build tools remain separate coverage work.

records.name: qcms-wrapper
records.evidence: Explicit PDF.js wrapper link; historical dependency resolution remains unresolved.

records.name: openjpeg-wrapper
records.evidence: Candidate wrapper from update history; includes stream patch and recipes, not historical toolchain proof.

records.name: openjpeg-source
records.evidence: Underlying revision explicitly identified by PDF.js update and wrapper recipe.

records.name: jbig2-wrapper
records.evidence: Both shipped decoder outputs reproduced exactly with this wrapper, pinned PDFium and Emscripten 6.0.9; see docs/JBIG2-REBUILD-EXPERIMENT.md. Historical toolchain and notice coverage remain separate questions.

records.name: pdfium-source
records.evidence: Underlying revision identified by JBIG2 wrapper. The wrapper's decoder subset reproduced both shipped outputs offline without external DEPS; this is not a complete PDFium build or toolchain-source delivery.

records.name: liberation-source
records.evidence: Original 1.07.4 SFD source tarball matches the Debian fonts-liberation 1:1.07.4-11 source descriptor. Use together with the collected Debian patches; the unpatched Cygwin fonts do not match PDF.js.

records.name: liberation-debian-patches
records.evidence: Debian fonts-liberation 1:1.07.4-11 source patches. All four Sans font binaries in that package match PDF.js exactly; its .dsc identifies the original source tarball already retained inside liberation-source.tar.xz. See docs/PDFJS-NESTED-SOURCE-REVIEW.md.

records.name: emscripten-6-0-9
records.evidence: Complete Emscripten 6.0.9 source archive, including bundled runtime-library sources, for the exact decoder reproduction recipe. Not a complete rebuild of the compiler image.

records.name: emscripten-6-0-10
records.evidence: Complete Emscripten 6.0.10 source archive, including bundled runtime-library sources, for the exact decoder reproduction recipe. Not a complete rebuild of the compiler image.

records.name: rust-runtime-source
records.evidence: Official Rust 1.97.1 source component; published checksum and embedded commit match the QCMS reproduction compiler. Includes standard library, compiler-builtins, lockfile and vendored dependencies; not a standard-library binary rebuild.
